text: みずがにがてで　あめが　ふりだすと　いつのまにか　すがたを　けす。

structure.en: it is bad with water, and

structure.jp: あめが　ふりだすと

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. あめが　ふりだすと = 'when it starts to rain'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the 'and' form of だ, joining this part to the rest of the sentence. みずがにがてで = 'it dislikes water, and'.

patterns.name: 〜だす
patterns.explanation: だす added to a verb stem means the action suddenly starts. ふりだす = 'start to fall (rain)'.
